scope: One finite engineering qualification of a document identity retrieval guard, not a benchmark or general recall claim. The separate LoRA allocation remains HOLD.

corpus.matrix_row_order: sorted old-exposed corpus document IDs then known retired548; reserved24 and remaining122 never encoded
corpus.only_known_positive: 548 has authoritative normalized full-text alias515; denominator1 descriptive only

documents: 262 flat records: document_id, source_document_sha256/source_utf8_bytes, normalized_document_sha256, bge_input_sha256/bge_input_utf8_bytes, vector_row, normalized_text_input_ref. No duplicated corpus text in raw; frozen bank provides exact normalized text.

normalization.alias_authority: Existing historical casefold+split/join-whitespace normalized full text and SHA256 remain unchanged. ANN scores never redefine aliases.
normalization.model_input: unicodedata.normalize(NFKC, authoritative_normalized_text).casefold(); preserve whitespace separators; no query prefix. Independent BGE text SHA/UTF8 bytes frozen.
normalization.attention: Original BGE small CLS model,256 token cap. Right truncation retains CLS+first254 content tokens+SEP; record exact actual IDs/padding/masks/full token count. Full-document hashes do not prove full-document attention.

vectors.data_base64: canonical RFC4648, actual normalized np.float32 little-endian C-order bytes, no quantization

native_result.IDs: Original hit.id is a canonical decimal string; raw_ids and filtered IDs are integers. One genuine search per input vector. Self queries request17, remove exact selfID, take first16;548 requests16. Preserve native order/score without reinterpretation.
native_result.hit: Every original nonvector field and raw_keys retained. Validate returned vector keys0..383, finite exact float32 and byte equality to indexed source row before stripping ONLY numeric vector values.

vector_receipt.source_vector_row: integer in full matrix row order
vector_receipt.source_sha256: SHA256 exact indexed source row bytes

native_result.failure: Active actual unvalidated query/hits retained on failure, with diagnostic nonfinite markers if needed. No failures or counters omitted.

dense.elapsed_seconds: actual complete exhaustive nonself cosine/ranking work
dense.method: math.fsum float64 cosine of exactfloat32 bits, exclude self BEFORE dots, numericID tie break; no dense row reuse

queries.identity_status: CONFIRMED_NORMALIZED_ALIAS only when a retained candidate has equal authoritative full normalized SHA; otherwise UNRESOLVED. Never CLEAN.
queries.near_pairs: []; optional character-Jaccard disabled, no semantic duplicate proof

counter_scope.native: 1 helper/binary load/index,261 insertions,2 genuine len checks,1 core.version metadata call,262 genuine search calls,4453 returned hit validations,4192 retained hits

CPU: Entire Python worker pinned0,1 beforeexec, no_new_privs + inherited seccomp denies203/native+x32 sched_setaffinity. Node inherits, no affinity reset. Read-only observed task snapshots; total OS threads need notbe2.
